classification.difficultyReason: Form simultaneous equations from equal opposite sides, solve them and calculate the perimeter.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of the rectangle shown below.

spec.sourceRegion: Review exercise question 20, rectangle beneath the instruction
spec.description: Unshaded horizontal rectangle with all four algebraic side labels. The decorative blue source outline is rendered black under house style. Drawing dimensions are layout dimensions, not mathematical givens.
spec.mathematics: Top x+y+2; bottom 2x+1; left 2y; right x+2. Opposite sides of the rectangle are equal. No units or equality ticks are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: All four given labels remain visible; no answers appear in the question diagram.

answer.short:
$30$.

Equate opposite sides to find $x=4$ and $y=3$, then add the four side lengths.
answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.

$$\begin{align*}x+y+2&=2x+1\\y-x&=-1\\2y&=x+2\\2y-x&=2\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $y-x=-1$ from $2y-x=2$ gives:

$$\begin{align*}y&=2-(-1)\\y&=3\end{align*}$$

Substituting into $2y=x+2$:

$$\begin{align*}2(3)&=x+2\\x&=4\end{align*}$$

The side lengths are $2x+1=9$ and $2y=6$.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2(9)+2(6)\\P&=30\end{align*}$$
